product.name: YNGVAR chair
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a board and 2 pieces
steps.instruction: Join a board and 2 pieces (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A board and 2 pieces are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the YNGVAR chair. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (board, about 33 cm), B (piece, about 62 cm), C (piece, about 35 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
